project_name: AI Mobile Test Studio — Enterprise Android Recorder MVP
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / IDE & DEVTOOLS (Swiss Precision Meets Appium Inspector)
design_principles: Information Density with Zero Clutter: Emulate JetBrains, Appium Inspector, and Postman density with 1px precise borders and clear panel splitters.
State Machine Clarity: Always clearly expose live recorder states (IDLE, STARTING, RECORDING, PAUSED, STOPPING, COMPLETED, FAILED) with dynamic status badges and pulse indicators.
Developer Accessibility: High-contrast code panels with monospace alignment for xpaths, package names, ADB serial numbers, and device metrics.
Bilingual First: Every piece of UI text must support Turkish (Default) and English seamlessly.
Context Preservation: Use slide-over inspector drawers and tabs rather than full page transitions when viewing step details, XML hierarchy, or JSON payloads.

layout_and_navigation.app_shell: Sidebar navigation + Top Header with Device/Agent status summary + Main resizable/pane workspace
layout_and_navigation.top_header_height: h-14 border-b border-border bg-card px-4 flex items-center justify-between

key_components: Agent & ADB Device Status Overview Cards
Quick Action Panel (Start Recording, Select Device, View Last Session)
Recent Recording Sessions Table (Device, Duration, Step Count, Status, Actions)
Recorded Step Metrics Chart (Action distribution: Click, Swipe, Type, Assert)
System Health & Latency Monitor Widget
Local Recorder Agent Connection Status Bar (Connected / Disconnected Banner)
ADB Devices Table (Model, OS Version, Serial Number, Battery %, Connection Type USB/Wifi, Status ONLINE/OFFLINE/RECORDING, Select Active Device CTA)
Refresh Devices Button with Spinner
Agent Pairing Token & Port Configuration Quick Modal
Empty State component when Local Recorder Agent is not running
Recorder Control Header (Start, Pause, Resume, Stop, Clear, Save, Export JSON)
Status Indicator (IDLE, STARTING, RECORDING, PAUSED, STOPPING, COMPLETED, FAILED) with animated pulse badge
Session Details Bar (Duration Counter 00:00:00, Action Count, Active Package Name e.g. com.bank.mobile)
Live Device Mirroring View (Latest captured Android screen + interactive bounding boxes for detected UI nodes)
Live Event Feed Drawer (Streaming logs of touch, gesture, and hierarchy dump events)
Quick Assertion / Verification Point Injector
Filterable Sessions Data Table (Session ID, Device Model, Package Name, Total Steps, Duration, Created At, Triggered By, Actions)
Batch Export (JSON, Appium Test script stub)
Session Details Drawer with execution logs
Interactive Step Timeline (Step #, Action Icon, Action Type, Target Element Label, Primary Locator e.g. XPath/Resource-ID, AI Confidence Badge %, Capture Source ADB/Accessibility, Thumbnail)
Step Reordering & Warning Alert for dependency shifts
Inspect Slide-Over Drawer (Raw XML Tree Inspector, Raw JSON Payload, Step Name Edit, Description, Verification Point Toggle, Remove Step)
Locator Strategy Switcher (Accessibility ID, Resource ID, XPath, Relative Coordinates)
Agent Configuration (Pairing Token, Host/Port, Heartbeat Interval)
Capture & Precision Settings (Screenshot frequency ms, Quality %, High-FPS Mode)
Security & Sensitive Data Masking (Redaction Toggle, Masking Keyword Tag Input e.g. 'password, secret, ssn, pin, token')
Data Retention & Cleanup (Log Retention Days)
UI & Localization (Language selection TR/EN, Dark/Light Theme Switcher)
Audit Log Table (User actions, config updates, agent pairings)

instructions_for_main_agent: 1. Read state & preferences from React context or local storage for dark/light theme and TR/EN language.
2. Implement a unified layout header with a live Agent Connection Status Badge (Green pulse when connected, Amber warning when disconnected).
3. On the Devices page, include a simulated toggle to mimic 'Agent Connected' vs 'Agent Disconnected' state to easily demonstrate the empty state.

4. For the Recorder page, build a full state machine using React state (IDLE -> STARTING -> RECORDING -> PAUSED -> STOPPING -> COMPLETED / FAILED) with realistic timer, live step counter, and interactive screen screenshot mirror.

5. For Recorded Steps, support drag/reorder or move up/down with confirmation warning, editing step name/locator, adding verification point (assertion), and opening a side drawer for XML hierarchy & JSON view.
6. Ensure all 'Planned' pages (Locator Inspector, AI Analysis, Code Generator, Jira Integration) display a crisp 'Planned — Not Implemented' banner with roadmap details.
7. Ensure 100% test coverage readiness by attaching data-testid attributes to all controls.
